narr: Monsoon moisture plus a weak trough approaching from the west fueled scattered thunderstorms over Mohave County. Some storms produced flash flooding.
ev: Vock Wash flowed over Stockton Hill Road.
Flash flooding off the Flag Fire scar affected the Pine Lake community and the summer camp inside Hualapai Park. Water flowed into several structures.
